summary: Computes the composite score for a named entrant by summing its scoring values across all but the first scoring category from the standings node at dword_7D2DB0. Returns the accumulated sum (starting from -1), or -1 when the standings node is absent, the category count is below 2, or no matching entry is found.

operations.description: Dereference the standings node from dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference.
When the standings node is absent, skip all work and return the default -1.
Read the number of scoring categories from the node via FlagsGetter into v4.
When the category count is less than 2, return -1.
Resolve the entrant's scoring entry (a list of per-category values) via ScoringSessionStatsAggregator(this, 0).
For each category index below v4 - 1, accumulate IndexedFieldGetter(entry, index) into the result v2, starting from v2 = -1.
Return the accumulated composite score v2.
